titleEnglish: Qaṣīdatu s-Salām — The Poem of Peace
note: Repeat the refrain after each set of verses.

verses.ar:
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهْ ۞ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهْ
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهْ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللّٰهْ
verses.tr: Lā ilāha illa Llāh · lā ilāha illa Llāh · Lā ilāha illa Llāh · Muḥammadun Rasūlu Llāh
verses.en: There is no god but Allah, there is no god but Allah. There is no god but Allah; Muhammad is the Emissary of Allah.

verses.ar:
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى قَبْرٍ يُزَارُ مِنَ الْبُعْدِ ۞
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى الرَّوْضَةْ وَفِيهَا مُحَمَّدِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalā qabrin yuzāru mina l-buʿdi · Salāmun ʿalā r-Rawḍa wa fīhā Muḥammadin
verses.en: Peace and greetings to a grave that is visited from afar. Peace be upon the Garden wherein lies Muhammad.

verses.ar:
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى مَنْ زَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ رَبَّهُ ۞
فَبَلَّغَهُ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِي كُلِّ مَقْصَدِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalā man zāra fī l-layli Rabbahu · Fa-ballaghahu l-marghūba fī kulli maqṣadin
verses.en: Peace upon him who in the night visited his Lord, who granted him attainment of his desire in all he aspired to.

verses.ar:
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى مَنْ قَالَ لِلضَّبِّ مَنْ أَنَا ۞
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ أَنْتَ مُحَمَّدِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalā man qāla li-ḍ-ḍabbi man anā · Fa-qāla Rasūlu Llāhi anta Muḥammadin
verses.en: Peace be upon him who asked a lizard, “Who am I?” And it replied, “The Emissary of Allah. You are Muhammad.”

verses.ar:
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى الْمَدْفُونِ فِي أَرْضِ طَيْبَةَ ۞
وَمَنْ خَصَّهُ الرَّحْمَانُ بِالْفَضْلِ وَالْمَجْدِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalā l-madfūni fī arḍi Ṭaybata · wa man khaṣṣahu r-Raḥmānu bi-l-faḍli wa l-majdi
verses.en: Peace upon the one buried in the land of Tayba (Madinah), and whom the All-Merciful singled out for pre-eminence and glory.

verses.ar:
نَبِيٌّ حَبَاهُ اللّٰهُ بِالْحُسْنِ وَالْبَهَا ۞
فَطُوبَى لِعَبْدٍ زَارَ قَبْرَ مُحَمَّدِ
verses.tr: Nabiyyun ḥabāhu Llāhu bi-l-ḥusni wa l-bahā · Fa-ṭūbā li-ʿabdin zāra qabra Muḥammadin
verses.en: A Prophet whom Allah granted beauty and splendour. Blessed, then, is any servant of Allah who visits the grave of Muhammad.

verses.ar:
أَيَا رَاكِبًا نَحْوَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَاصِدًا ۞
فَبَلِّغْ سَلَامِي لِلْحَبِيبِ مُحَمَّدِ
verses.tr: Ayā rākiban naḥwa l-Madīnati qāṣidan · fa-balligh salāmī li-l-ḥabībi Muḥammadin
verses.en: O you who are riding straight ahead towards Madinah, convey my greetings to the Beloved Muhammad.

verses.ar:
فِي رَوْضَتِهِ الْحُسْنَى مُنَايَ وَبُغْيَتِي ۞
وَفِيهَا شِفَا قَلْبِي وَرُوحِي وَرَاحَتِي
verses.tr: Fī Rawḍatihi l-ḥusnā munāya wa bughyatī · wa fīhā shifā qalbī wa rūḥī wa rāḥatī
verses.en: Within his most lovely Garden is my sole desire and goal; therein lies the remedy for my heart and soul, and therein my comfort.

verses.ar:
فَإِنْ بَعُدَتْ عَنِّي وَعَزَّ مَزَارُهَا ۞
فَتِمْثَالُهَا لَدَيَّ أَحْسَنُ صُورَةِ
verses.tr: Fa-in baʿudat ʿannī wa ʿazza mazāruhā · fa-timthāluhā ladayya aḥsanu ṣūratin
verses.en: For although it is far from me and difficult to visit, the picture of it in my mind's eye is the loveliest of forms.

verses.ar:
أُنَزِّهُ طَرْفَ الْعَيْنِ فِي حُسْنِ رَوْضِهَا ۞
فَيَسْلُو بِهَا لُبِّي وَسِرِّي وَمُهْجَتِي
verses.tr: Unazzihu ṭarfa l-ʿayni fī ḥusni rawḍihā · fa-yaslū bihā lubbī wa sirrī wa muhjatī
verses.en: I cleanse my eyesight by picturing the beauty of its gardens, so that my mind, being and inmost soul find solace.

verses.ar:
فَهَا أَنَا يَا قُطْبَ الْعَوَالِمِ كُلِّهَا ۞
أُقَبِّلُهَا شَوْقًا لِإِشْفَاءِ عِلَّتِي
verses.tr: Fa-hā anā yā Quṭba l-ʿAwālimi kullihā · Uqabbiluhā shawqan li-ishfā'i ʿillatī
verses.en: So here I am, O Axis of the entire Universe! I place my lips on it in yearning, to have my ailment healed.

verses.ar:
وَصَلِّ عَلٰى قُطْبِ الْوُجُودِ مُحَمَّدِ ۞
صَلَاةً بِهَا تَمْحُو عَنَّا كُلَّ زَلَّةِ
verses.tr: Wa ṣalli ʿalā Quṭbi l-wujūdi Muḥammadin · Ṣalātan bihā tamḥū ʿannā kulla zallatin
verses.en: Send prayers upon the Centre of all creation, Muhammad, prayers through which all our shortcomings are effaced.
